title: The Pump Is Not on the Screen
summary: Real letter. Fake date. Einstein's April 10 1948 letter to Shepard Rifkin (a Lehi fundraiser; "misled and criminal people"; sold at Sotheby's 2007) went around under a mock 1952 "Occupied Palestine" masthead, headlined "warning about Israel", with a caption describing a different document: the Dec 4 1948 New York Times letter (Arendt, Hook, Einstein) calling Begin's party "closely akin" to the Nazi and Fascist parties. Israel was declared May 14 1948; the April letter never names it. Specimen two: a WTI chart posted upside down to argue the Fed should cut; right side up oil climbed, and the Fed had held 33 minutes earlier with two dissents for a hike. Specimen three: CZ's Dec 15 2022 CNBC "we are financially strong" clip reposted as if about this week's Binance hack (Binance's own figure ~$6.3B, ~$3B frozen). The fake isn't the letter; the fake is the caption. Intent: not established for any poster.
variable_tested: posting time ~9:30 PM ET (window 9:20-9:40) vs the 7:56-8:06 PM slot, per the Oct 29 rule (122 views at ~23.6 h = neutral); confounds: 'spot the label' triptych format (scissors cut the caption to reveal the real date/axis/year), faster cuts (37 shots, mean 2.17 s, max 3.77 s), 4-word hook (1.12 s), Einstein/oil/CZ lane

title: User Funds Are Safe
summary: Hard cap? They printed billions. Bitcoin's 21 million cap was blown through once: on Aug 15 2010 one transaction put 0.5 BTC in and sent just over 92 billion out to each of two addresses (~184 billion), forked away within hours because miners ran the patched software (the cap holds by agreement: our read, I). Oct 29, 4:24 PM ET: Binance hot wallets sent billions to a fresh address seeded through Tornado Cash (counts $2.5B-$5.7B, unconfirmed); the only brakes were Tether and Circle freezes; the former CEO, as a shareholder: "User funds are safe." Google estimates a not-yet-built quantum machine could break Bitcoin's keys in minutes (method withheld, zero-knowledge proof attached); BIP 360 renamed three times, activated zero. The cap counts the coins; it never said whose they are. SAID and DONE kept apart, with receipts.

title: Who Set the Speed Limit
summary: SAID: Secretary of State Marco Rubio at Joint Base Andrews Sat Oct 17: nobody in the US ordered Starlink speeds slowed in Ukraine, 'it sort of happened'. Rubio in Mumbai Wed Oct 21: 'this decision' is governed by a private commercial contract, what speeds they allow; 'we cannot direct a private company'; Starshield is sold and operated through the Department of War. Musk Oct 14: Starshield is owned and controlled by the US government, limits by the military and ultimately POTUS. Hegseth Oct 20: that's where Starlink has the option to make those decisions. Trump Oct 16: 'I don't know if it was anybody' (full cut). DONE: Ukraine's defense ministry (interested party): military Starshield terminals cut out above about 161 km/h since Oct 14; CBS Oct 20-21: Zelensky's office says still throttled. Contract text not published. Receipts: 2022 SpaceX letter asking the Pentagon to fund Ukraine terminals (CNN), Musk 'the hell with it... free', Pentagon confirms contracting June 1 2023 (Defense News); Musk Sep 7 2023 on refusing an emergency request to activate Starlink to Sevastopol. title: Ninety-Five Percent of What
summary: SAID: CENTCOM spokesman Tim Hawkins told Al Jazeera Tue Oct 20 (9:33 AM ET) the Strait of Hormuz is "open and secure" and 95% of ships cross safely, with no denominator or start date.
